name: Trouble In Paradise VR
summary:
Can you handle a grand adventure of 26 levels, increasing difficulty and NO CHECKPOINTS?! If so…

There is TROUBLE IN PARADISE!

Trouble in paradise takes place in the tropical town of North Beach Village where Chico and his townspeople are just having a normal day in the Barrio when suddenly, it has been taken over by Captain Jefe! His henchmen quickly take over the village and surrounding cities! It’s up to Chico and his awesome crew of awesome homies to defend the town and nearby cities with his Mighty B
